title: geophila repens
intro: Geophila repens, commonly known as creeping Jenny or money plant, is a flowering plant that belongs to the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). It is native to Asia and Europe and is often used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being, and its therapeutic actions include sedative and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Geophila repens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
